markdown:
I don't think people realize how observant I am.

I notice the small changes, the energy, and the little things people think they hide so well. I can feel when something is off, even before a word is said. I catch the truth in the way someone speaks, avoids, or suddenly starts acting different.

So when I ask questions, just know: I already know the truth. I'm just giving you the chance to be honest with me. And if you still choose to lie, that tells me everything I need to know.

Because nothing hurts more than watching someone betray you while looking you in the eye.
